componentDescriptions.LabelRow (State=Default, Node ID 86:941):
Purpose: A label row displayed above every input field. Part of every FormField.

Structure: A <div> with display: flex, flex-direction: row, align-items: center, gap: var(--space-2), padding-bottom: var(--space-2).

Contains:
- Label text (always visible)
- Required indicator * (optional)
- Info icon ⓘ circle-info, 16×16px (optional, right-aligned)

Token references:
- Typography: var(--font-size-sm), var(--font-weight-regular)
- Required *: var(--font-weight-black)
- Color: var(--color-text-default)
- Gap: var(--space-2)
- Padding-bottom: var(--space-2)

Agent instructions:
- Always sits directly above an Input component
- Info icon uses circle-info from the design system icon set — no external icons
- Accept: label, required (boolean), showInfoIcon (boolean) as props
componentDescriptions.HelperRow (Node ID 86:957):
Purpose: A helper text row displayed below every input field. Provides validation feedback.

Variants (state prop):
- Default — text only, no icon: color var(--color-text-default)
- Success — circle-check icon + text: color var(--color-success)
- Error — triangle-exclamation icon + text: color var(--color-error)

Structure: A <div> with display: flex, flex-direction: row, align-items: center, gap: var(--space-2), padding-top: var(--space-1).

Token references:
- Typography: var(--font-size-sm), var(--font-weight-regular)
- Color (Default): var(--color-text-default)
- Color (Success): var(--color-success)
- Color (Error): var(--color-error)
- Gap: var(--space-2)
- Padding-top: var(--space-1)
- Icon size: 16×16px

Agent instructions:
- Always sits directly below an Input component
- Icons come from the design system only: circle-check and triangle-exclamation
- Accept: state ('default' | 'success' | 'error'), message (string) as props
